|translation='''Title:''' Owen Lars.

'''Card text:''' Deploys for free to [[Lars' Moisture Farm|Lars' Moisture Farm]]. Power +2 at the same site card as [[Beru Lars|Beru Lars]] or a [[Vaporator|Vaporator]]. If he goes to the Lost Pile during your opponent's turn, Luke is power +3 until the end of your next turn.

'''Lore:''' [[Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]]'s guardian, [[Beru Lars|Beru Lars]]'s husband, and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s younger brother. Owner of a moisture farm. He objected to Luke's wish to leave Tatooine.
